test_access: Only after validation selection has been sealed; same selected checkpoint for all test conditions
seed_and_failure_rule: Run all five predefined complete A/B/C pairs. No result-dependent seed addition or budget shortening. Record failures; any changed sampling/update protocol requires a new lock and rerunning affected paired comparisons.
resume_rule: All runs restart at round 50 from their own checkpoint with new physics and cleared replay. Fixed-input verification trials and diagnostics are excluded from training counters.

decision_rationale.keep_H4: At the two recorded episode heads per group, bootstrap/reward actor gradient norm ratios are 0.0241/0.0231/0.0191 despite large numerical bootstrap fractions. This is local evidence, not a guarantee for other starts.
decision_rationale.increase_external_budget: The ten-round pilot completed reliably but did not establish control learning. Process residual moments and posterior coverage remain poorly calibrated on common walking records. Increase every group to 100 rounds while retaining the same fit and sampling rules.

resource_projection.exclusions: Startup, fixed-input verification, evaluation, independent diagnostics and backups. Evaluation cost grows with survival; retain full-clip protocol without external truncation.
